title: FLA import: unrecognised class tags and stream truncation cause Magnet.fla to render blank
description:
Loading fixtures/Magnet.fla produces 24 console warnings and results in a completely black stage and blank Test Movie output.

## Symptoms observed
- Stage canvas is solid black after loading Magnet.fla
- Control → Test Movie opens Ruffle but shows blank light-blue canvas (no game content)
- 24 browser console warnings on load, all from flash8-binary.ts:236 and flash8-import.ts:622

## Console warnings (flash8-binary.ts:236)
Unrecognised class tags causing 'skipping remaining children':
- tag 0x2 (multiple offsets: 0x92a, 0x758, 0x24cb, 0x6e7, 0x7e3, 0x7bd, 0x7ed, 0x778, 0x1276f)
- tag 0x102 (offsets: 0x43a, 0x2b23c)
- tag 0x202 (offsets: 0x9b3, 0xa5e, 0x1734)
- tag 0x204 (offset: 0x7c2)

Stream truncation errors:
- 'stream truncated while reading CPicFrame: Error: need 1 bytes at 0x78d2, only 0 left'
- 'stream truncated while reading CPicFrame: Error: need 1 bytes at 0x9b1d, only 0 left'
- 'stream truncated while reading CPicFrame: Error: need 1 bytes at 0x72d0, only 0 left'
- 'stream truncated while reading CPicFrame: Error: need 1 bytes at 0x127b, only 0 left'

## Expected
Stage should display the first scene content (scene 'AA', 2 layers, 57 frames) and Test Movie should launch a playable game (Magnet is a claw-machine game with 6 scenes, 87 library items including 25 bitmaps).

## FLA structure loaded
6 scenes (AA, Scene 2, Scene 5, BA, AB, BB), 87 library items (25 bitmaps, 62 symbols including Claw.swft, Preloader, Progress bar, WW1/WW2/WW3 MCs).
